provenance.note: Controlled terms for the fields FAIR I2 scores. Licence identifiers are SPDX short identifiers; data types are this tool's own small list, chosen to be few enough that a person will actually pick one. A free-text value is never rejected — it is recorded and reported as uncontrolled, because refusing the user's own word for their data would be worse than scoring it.

pronom.name: PRONOM technical registry
pronom.status: Format identification by PRONOM PUID is not implemented; formats are recorded by extension, which is weaker and labelled as such.

licenses.label: Not for sharing — personal or confidential
licenses.note: An explicit decision, which scores differently from a blank. FAIR R1.1 asks for a clear licence, and 'this is private' is a clear answer; leaving it empty is not.

relation_types.$comment: DataCite relationType values this tool proposes or accepts.

format_risk.$comment: Extension-based, which is weaker than PRONOM identification and is reported as such. 'at-risk' means proprietary, undocumented, or dependent on software that is no longer maintained — not that the file is damaged.
